title: disktop clean --json
description: Everything the providers found, with nothing applied. `providers` lists every detector that ran, including the ones that could not look, so a short finding list is never mistaken for an empty disk.

measured.description: False when sizes were not measured, which is why findings may carry an unknown size.

providers.description: Every detector that was asked, including the ones that could not look. A category filter that matches no detector leaves this empty; it is never omitted.
